name: qlrisk_price_commodity_forward
title: Price a CommodityForward
description:
Price one Commodity Forward (qlrisk CommodityForward).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, strike, quantity, commodity=WTI, convenience_yield_pct=0, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, spot, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
